classification.difficultyReason: Trapezoidal prism with all lengths supplied; use the trapezium area and four rectangles.

content.prompt: Find the surface area of the trapezoidal prism.

answer.worked:
Front and back: $2\times\frac12(13+7)\times8=160\text{ cm}^2$.

Top: $7\times15=105\text{ cm}^2$.

Base: $13\times15=195\text{ cm}^2$.

Left side: $8\times15=120\text{ cm}^2$.

Slanted side: $10\times15=150\text{ cm}^2$.

$$\begin{align*}SA&=160+105+195+120+150\\SA&=730\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
